title: Clearer directory groups on staff profile
summary: Directory groups on staff profile and admin user pages now show as wrapping chips instead of a hard-to-scan comma-separated list.
changes: Replaced the comma-separated monospace directory groups list with wrapping chips on the staff profile page.
Applied the same chip layout to normalized directory groups on the admin user detail page.
Added Local QA sample directory groups for staff, admin, and superadmin accounts so the layout is easy to check locally.
version_rationale: A backward-compatible patch that only changes how existing directory group values are displayed.
known_limitations: Directory group names remain as stored Cloudron identifiers; this release does not rename or humanize them.
rollback: Revert this release record, VERSION, runtime manifest version, the directory group list component and styles, related blade updates, Local QA seeder group fixtures, and related tests.
provenance: Defined by the staff profile directory groups readability fix for MyAPES Account issue #87 and pull request #88.
